description: This file contains the implementation of an in-memory data access object (DAO) for ProfileEntity objects, supporting operations such as insert, delete, get, and observing all profiles via a Flow. It serves as a fallback when Room database initialization fails, ensuring the app remains functional.

classes.name: InMemoryProfileDao
classes.description: A Kotlin class implementing ProfileDao for in-memory profile data management, supporting reactive updates via Flow.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the list of all profiles, newest first.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a ProfileEntity into memory, assigning a new ID if necessary, and returns the ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified profile entity from memory.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a profile by its ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by ID, or null if not found.
